nodes.name: clex.py
nodes.summary: PLY lexer for ANSI C that tokenizes C source code into language tokens including identifiers, keywords, preprocessor directives, comments, and operators, using a reserved word map for keyword detection.

nodes.name: cparse.py
nodes.summary: PLY parser for ANSI C grammar implementing the full C language specification with 170 production rules covering declarations, expressions, statements, and control flow constructs.

nodes.name: calc.py

nodes.name: calc.py
nodes.summary: PLY calculator example with debug mode enabled, demonstrating how to trace parser construction and parsing steps for educational purposes.

nodes.name: calc.py
nodes.summary: PLY calculator example using a class-based approach where lex and grammar rules are encapsulated within a Calc class, demonstrating object-oriented parser organization.

nodes.name: hedit.py
nodes.summary: Minimal PLY lexer example implementing H-edit descriptor tokenization for processing hexadecimal edit commands.

nodes.name: calc.py
nodes.summary: PLY calculator using the new-style class-based API where lex and yacc rules are defined as class methods, demonstrating the recommended PLY pattern for modular parser construction.

nodes.name: calc.py
nodes.summary: PLY calculator example with optimization enabled, demonstrating how to use the optimize flag for faster parser table generation using cached tables.

nodes.name: calc.py
nodes.summary: PLY unit-aware calculator example demonstrating how to implement expression parsing with dimensional analysis and unit conversions.

nodes.name: lex.py
nodes.summary: Core PLY lexer module providing tokenization infrastructure including the Lexer class, LexerReflect introspection, state management, regex-based token matching, and lextab-based optimization. This is the foundational lexical analysis engine for the PLY parser generator.
nodes.languageNotes: Python implementation using regex named groups for token dispatch, with support for lexer states, EOF handlers, and optional lextab module caching.

nodes.name: yacc.py
nodes.summary: Core PLY LALR(1) parser generator implementing grammar specification, LR table construction, shift-reduce parsing with error recovery, precedence handling, and parser table serialization. This is the foundational parsing engine for the PLY library.
nodes.languageNotes: Complete LALR(1) parser generator with LR(0) item sets, LALR lookahead computation, and multiple parse modes (debug, optimized, no-track).

nodes.name: p_type_specifier
nodes.summary: Grammar rule handling ANSI C type specifiers including void, char, short, int, long, float, double, signed, unsigned, and struct/union/enum specifiers.

nodes.name: p_assignment_operator
nodes.summary: Grammar rule defining all C assignment operators including simple assignment and compound assignments like +=, -=, *=, and bitwise operators.

nodes.name: p_statement
nodes.summary: Grammar rule dispatching between labeled, expression, compound, selection, iteration, and jump statement types for ANSI C.

nodes.name: p_expression_binop
nodes.summary: Grammar rule for binary arithmetic expressions handling addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and modulo with proper operator precedence.

nodes.name: t_H_EDIT_DESCRIPTOR
nodes.summary: Token rule for H-edit descriptors that parses hexadecimal address and byte count from indexed edit commands.

nodes.name: lex
nodes.summary: Main PLY lexer entry point that reads module-level token specifications, builds the Lexer instance, validates rules, compiles regex patterns, and optionally writes or reads cached lextab modules for faster startup.

nodes.name: _form_master_re
nodes.summary: Internal helper that compiles individual token regex patterns into a combined master regular expression per lexer state, handling named groups and function-based token dispatch.

nodes.name: _statetoken
nodes.summary: Internal helper that parses state-qualified token names (e.g., 'INITIAL,token_name') to extract state and token components for conditional lexer rules.

nodes.name: runmain
nodes.summary: Interactive lexer test harness that reads input from a file or stdin and prints token stream output, useful for debugging token definitions.

nodes.name: TOKEN
nodes.summary: Decorator that attaches a regex pattern string to a token function, enabling inline regex specification for complex token patterns.

nodes.name: yacc
nodes.summary: Main PLY parser generator entry point that reads grammar rules from a module, constructs the Grammar, builds LALR parse tables via LRGeneratedTable, creates the LRParser, and optionally serializes tables to disk.

nodes.name: call_errorfunc
nodes.summary: Error function dispatcher that wraps user-provided p_error functions, handling both bound and unbound method signatures consistently.

nodes.name: digraph
nodes.summary: Implements the digraph algorithm for LALR lookahead set computation, traversing the lookback relation graph to compute read and follow sets.

nodes.name: traverse
nodes.summary: Recursive graph traversal helper used by the digraph algorithm to compute transitive closures for LALR lookahead propagation.

nodes.name: parse_grammar
nodes.summary: Alternative grammar specification parser that extracts production rules from docstrings, supporting C-style grammar notation within Python strings.

nodes.name: Parser
nodes.summary: Abstract parser base class for the class-based PLY calculator, providing initialization from a module path and a run loop for interactive input.

nodes.name: Calc
nodes.summary: Main calculator class encapsulating lexer token rules and parser grammar productions as class methods, demonstrating the class-based PLY pattern for arithmetic expression evaluation.

nodes.name: Parser
nodes.summary: Abstract parser base class for the new-style PLY calculator, providing initialization with automatic lex/yacc construction and an interactive run loop.

nodes.name: Calc
nodes.summary: New-style calculator class with lexer tokens and parser grammar as class methods, demonstrating the recommended PLY pattern for modular parser construction.

nodes.name: Lexer
nodes.summary: Core lexer runtime class implementing input buffering, token-by-token scanning via compiled regex dispatch, lexer state management (push/pop), error handling, and EOF management. The primary workhorse of the PLY lexer.

nodes.name: LexerReflect
nodes.summary: Reflection/introspection class that scans a user module for PLY lexer specifications -- tokens lists, literals, state declarations, and token rules with regex patterns -- and validates them for correctness.

nodes.name: LexToken
nodes.summary: Simple container class for lexer tokens storing type, value, line number, and lexer position with string representation methods.

nodes.name: PlyLogger
nodes.summary: Logger wrapper that writes PLY diagnostic messages (critical, warning, error) to an output file, used for debugging lexer construction.

nodes.name: NullLogger
nodes.summary: Silent logger that discards all messages by returning itself via __getattribute__, used as a default when no debug logging is requested.

nodes.name: LRParser
nodes.summary: Core LALR parser runtime implementing three parsing modes: debug (verbose tracing), optimized (fast with error tracking), and notrack (fastest without tracking). Manages parse stack, action/goto tables, error recovery, and lookahead handling.

nodes.name: Grammar
nodes.summary: Grammar representation class that stores all productions, terminals, nonterminals, precedence rules, and start symbol. Provides validation methods including unreachable symbol detection, infinite cycle checking, and FIRST/FOLLOW set computation.

nodes.name: LRGeneratedTable
nodes.summary: LR table generator class that computes LR(0) item sets, closure/goto operations, LALR lookahead sets using the digraph algorithm, and constructs the full action/goto parse tables with conflict warnings.

nodes.name: ParserReflect
nodes.summary: Reflection/introspection class that scans a user module for PLY parser specifications -- grammar functions, tokens, precedence, start symbol, and error handler -- and validates them before parser construction.

nodes.name: Production
nodes.summary: Grammar production rule representation storing LHS nonterminal, RHS symbols, precedence, and the associated callable. Supports LR item generation and symbol binding.

nodes.name: YaccProduction
nodes.summary: Parser production value container passed to grammar action functions, providing indexed access to symbol values, line number tracking, and slice operations similar to PLY's parser input semantics.

nodes.name: LRTable
nodes.summary: Base class for LR parse tables providing serialization and deserialization via Python pickle and module-based table loading from generated parser modules.

nodes.name: YaccSymbol
nodes.summary: Container class for grammar symbols on the parse stack, storing the symbol type and optional value with string representation.

nodes.name: LRItem
nodes.summary: LR(0) item representation storing a production with a dot position, used during LR table construction for closure and goto computation.

nodes.name: MiniProduction
nodes.summary: Lightweight production representation used during grammar debugging and informational display, providing a compact string view of production rules.

nodes.name: PlyLogger
nodes.summary: Logger wrapper that writes PLY diagnostic messages (debug, warning, error) to an output file, used during parser construction and debugging.

nodes.name: NullLogger
nodes.summary: Silent logger that discards all PLY parser diagnostic messages, used as a default no-op logger when debug is disabled.
